name: std::unordered_map<Key,T,Hash,KeyEqual,Allocator>::bucket_size
intro: Returns the number of elements in the bucket with index n.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
n

 -

 the index of the bucket to examine

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The number of elements in the bucket n.

sections.title: Complexity
sections.text: Linear in the size of the bucket n.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Insert keys 2, 3, and 4, then inspect the bucket holding key 2. Bucket counts and iteration order are implementation-dependent.

summary: Returns the number of elements in the bucket with index n.
